description: Core principles of management, leadership, strategy, and organizational behavior

management_functions.planning: Setting objectives and determining courses of action
management_functions.organizing: Structuring resources and tasks to achieve goals
management_functions.controlling: Monitoring performance and taking corrective action

leadership_styles.autocratic: Leader makes decisions alone; fast but demoralizing
leadership_styles.democratic: Team participates in decisions; slower but more buy-in
leadership_styles.laissez_faire: Leader gives autonomy; effective with skilled, motivated teams
leadership_styles.transformational: Inspires change and innovation; articulates compelling vision
leadership_styles.servant: Leader prioritizes team's needs and growth; builds trust
leadership_styles.situational: Adapts style to situation and team maturity (Hersey-Blanchard)

strategic_frameworks.swot: Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats; internal vs external

bcg_matrix.stars: High growth, high market share; invest
bcg_matrix.cash_cows: Low growth, high share; milk for cash
bcg_matrix.question_marks: High growth, low share; decide invest or exit

strategic_frameworks.balanced_scorecard: Performance measured across financial, customer, internal process, and learning/growth perspectives

organizational_structures.functional: Departments by function (marketing, finance, operations); efficiency
organizational_structures.divisional: Organized by product, market, or geography; flexibility
organizational_structures.matrix: Dual reporting; functional and project-based; complex
organizational_structures.flat: Few management layers; common in startups; fast communication
organizational_structures.hierarchical: Clear chain of command; stable but slow

herzberg_two_factor.hygiene: Presence prevents dissatisfaction (salary, job security); absence causes dissatisfaction

mcgregor.theory_x: People inherently dislike work; need control and coercion
mcgregor.theory_y: People are self-motivated; enjoy work; managers should empower

project_management.scrum: Agile framework; sprints, daily standups, retrospectives, product backlog
project_management.kanban: Visual workflow; limit work in progress
project_management.pmbok: Project Management Book of Knowledge; PMI standard
project_management.triple_constraint: Scope, time, cost; changing one affects others

key_business_metrics.ebitda: Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation, Amortization; operational profitability
key_business_metrics.clv: Customer Lifetime Value; total revenue expected from customer relationship
key_business_metrics.cac: Customer Acquisition Cost; total spent / customers acquired
key_business_metrics.nps: Net Promoter Score; likelihood customers will recommend; -100 to +100
